headline: Prime ESE with real period, but cross-onshore refuses to let up.
today: Best swell of the group on paper — ESE at 113, prime, with sets reaching 3ft at up to 9s — but the SSE cross-on blows 12-13mph most of the day. Dawn at 5mph is your cleanest shot before it stiffens; the longer-period lines will at least have some shape. Grab a shortboard or groveler for the early window and expect texture after that.

daysToWatch.note: Light NW-to-ESE dawn and morning wind over a 1.7-2.2ft SE swell — clean, if only a fair angle. Worth a look if you're closer to this one than Ditch.
NNE cross keeps it rideable early at 1.3-1.8ft good angle. Marginal, dawn only.
